title: Korea's constitution says the Republic shall seek peaceful unification based on the free democratic basic order
summary: Korea's constitution says the Republic shall seek peaceful unification based on the free democratic basic order.
body: Article 4 says the Republic shall seek unification and shall formulate and carry out a policy of peaceful unification based on the free democratic basic order. The source says: "Article 4 The Republic of Korea shall seek unification and shall formulate and carry out a policy of peaceful unification based on the free democratic basic order." The article states a policy duty and names the basis. It does not record the terms of any negotiation.
